facts.text: Discovery Gardens began as Jebel Ali Village in 1977 to house construction workers for Jebel Ali Port.
Nakheel Properties expanded the area from a small garden city to a modern residential community starting in 2008.
Security upgrades such as CCTV and electronic access were installed in 2012 after reports of unauthorized entry, boosting resident safety.
The Dubai Metro’s Route 2020 extension opened in January 2021, adding a dedicated Discovery Gardens station that links the area to Expo 2020.
Discovery Gardens is divided into six themed clusters—Zen, Mediterranean, Mogul, Mesoamerican, Cactus, and Contemporary—each centered around landscaped gardens.
The neighborhood is famed for its affordability, making it a top choice for families and first‑time renters seeking low‑cost apartments.
